id.description: Feature ID, format F-001, F-002... Optional sub-feature suffix: F-001-A

title.description: Feature title — brief description of the functionality

description.description: Detailed feature description: what it does, why it's needed

priority.description: Feature priority. Pipeline processes critical before high before medium before low; within same level, array order determines sequence.

estimated_complexity.description: Estimated implementation complexity. Determines pipeline execution tier: low/medium → lite (single agent), high → standard (orchestrator + dev + reviewer), critical → full (full team + critic).

dependencies.description: IDs of features that must be completed before this one

acceptance_criteria.description: Conditions that must be met for the feature to be considered complete

status.description: Feature status. Pipeline manages status transitions automatically.

session_granularity.description: Session execution strategy: feature=one-session-per-feature, sub_feature=one-session-per-sub-feature, auto=pipeline-decides

model.description: AI model ID for this feature. Overrides $MODEL env var.

critic.description: Enable adversarial plan challenge before implementation. Default: false.

critic_count.description: Number of parallel critic agents. 1 = single critic, 3 = multi-critic voting. Default: 1.

completion_notes.description: AI-generated summary of key changes from this feature session. Used to provide rich dependency context to downstream features. Each item is a concise statement about what was built/changed (e.g. APIs added, models created, key file paths).

user_context.description: User-provided supplementary materials, preserved verbatim. Each entry is either inline content/rules (stored as-is) or a file reference (e.g. 'src/auth/login.ts:42-78', 'src/utils/ — focus on validation logic').

browser_interaction.description: Browser verification config for features with UI. Supports playwright-cli and opencli. AI auto-detects dev server command, URL, and port from project config at runtime.

tool.description: Browser tool to use. 'auto' (default) = AI chooses at runtime. 'playwright-cli' = local dev server verification in isolated browser. 'opencli' = reuses Chrome logged-in session, ideal for verifying third-party integrations or OAuth flows.

verify_steps.description: Verification goals describing WHAT to verify (not HOW). AI decides concrete browser tool actions at runtime based on actual code and snapshot. If omitted, AI explores the app and verifies the feature works.
